newsitem.title: UK: Two Brents kept before deadline - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brents kept before deadline - trade.

text.p: Two cargoes of Brent loading June 28-30 were kept before the five o'clock deadline on Friday, traders said.
One was kept by J Aron and the other by Koch, they said.

Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date. A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
